segments.name: Privia Health Group, Inc.
segments.description: Organizes physicians into regional medical groups and supports them with technology, practice management, population health and value-based care services.
segments.evidence: Management determined in accordance with ASC Topic 280, Segment Reporting ("ASC 280"), that the Company operates in and reports as a single operating segment, which is to care for its patients' needs.

revenueModel.text: Patients, payers and employers pay Privia care management fees, administrative fees and shared savings for managing physician practices and patient care.
revenueModel.evidence: FFS-patient care revenue generated from providing healthcare services to patients through Privia Providers of Owned Medical Groups and Friendly Medical Groups
